risk_flags.description: The contract adds an unverified dependency on source-code definitions that the requester did not mention. If that file differs from the requested six currencies, the promise becomes ambiguous or could override the explicit requested list.
risk_flags.span: The listed currencies match exactly those defined in tally/rates.py

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the contract may treat tally/rates.py as authoritative over the requester's explicit currency list.
